games.description:
Blind Soldier makes Final Fantasy VII accessible to blind players by speaking menus, dialogue, battles, navigation targets, story objectives, objects, exits, and other information normally conveyed visually.

## Included runtime

This entry installs the self-contained x86 components required by Final Fantasy VII 2013. The private .NET runtime and Reloaded components are included. It does not install or modify 7th Heaven or FFNx.

## Hotkeys

- `R` - Repeat the last message Blind Soldier spoke
- `U` - Previous navigation category
- `O` - Next navigation category
- `J` - Previous target in the selected category
- `L` - Next target in the selected category
- `K` - Repeat the selected target, or report the active route and progress
- `I` - Start navigation to the selected target, or stop the active route
- `P` - Start or stop automatic walking to the selected navigation target
- `F5` - Turn route progress indicators off or on
- `F6` - Select the previous progress interval
- `F7` - Select the next progress interval
- `F8` - Toggle automatic steering during the motorcycle minigame

## Battle status hotkeys

These keys are active only during battle. `L` checks the selected member's limit gauge in battle and remains the next-target navigation key everywhere else.

- `1` - Select and identify party member 1
- `2` - Select and identify party member 2
- `3` - Select and identify party member 3
- `H` - Read current and maximum HP
- `M` - Read current and maximum MP
- `D` - Read active debuffs and other harmful conditions
- `S` - Read active buffs
- `L` - Read the native limit gauge percentage

## Navigation

Use `U` and `O` to choose a category, `J` and `L` to choose a target, and `I` to start or stop a route. Press `K` to repeat the route and progress. Keeping progress indicators enabled is recommended; `F5` toggles them, while `F6` and `F7` select 5, 10, 15, or 20 percent intervals.

defaultPostInstall.what: removes obsolete Blind Soldier registry launch values left by earlier manager packages
defaultPostInstall.why: Blind Soldier uses its native proxy bootstrap and does not require registry launch redirection
defaultPostInstall.modifies: only Blind Soldier-owned Image File Execution Options values for ff7_en.exe and FFVII.exe; unrelated values are preserved

ffviiold.notes: Fix Story and Object navigation routes treating their selected destination model as a blocking obstacle.
Fix the Steam 2026 startup bounce caused by Reloaded-II's broad delayed-hook race, and prevent duplicate Blind Soldier instances from producing repeated audio descriptions on either runtime.
Fix reactor story and ladder navigation, restore the original traversal cue, and add route-aware ladder mount, drift recovery, live landing completion, and stale-state suppression.
Blind Soldier v0.1.6 for Final Fantasy VII 2013: self-contained x86 package, hotkey documentation, and safe legacy registry cleanup.
Blind Soldier 0.1.7 for Final Fantasy VII 2013: current x86 runtime plus the startup-readiness fix shared by both brokers.
Blind Soldier 0.1.8 for Final Fantasy VII 2013: Wall Market Story routing, battle status hotkeys, Save speech restoration, and corrected Enemy Skill mapping.
Fix stock Steam 2013 startup with the sibling Version proxy and preserve mapped-drive paths for Reloaded discovery.
Blind Soldier 0.1.10 for Final Fantasy VII 2013: Config, Limit, and Order menu speech fixes plus R to repeat the last spoken message.
Blind Soldier 0.2.0 beta adds native Wall Market squat prompts for both supported FFVII runtimes.

Fix Echo-S opening-movie audio description when stock 7th Heaven and FFNx serve the movie without an ordinary file handle. Also includes multilingual accessibility support and the trimmed 2013 portable payload.
Fix Polish fan-translation dialogue so Prism speaks Polish special characters instead of unrelated symbols. Includes automatic Bunio V1.05 detection and the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.
Adds route-driven auto walk with P, progress reporting, swallowed-direction recovery, and repaired Train Graveyard story progression. Includes the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.
Fixes automatic Polish translation detection when the translated font is unavailable or replaced, and restores Continue save-file speech.
Restores field objectives after collected objects disappear and fixes direction reversals on active ladder routes. Includes the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.

Blind Soldier 0.2.5 adds world-map story routing and combat recovery, Kalm and Chocobo Ranch accessibility, Lower Junon descriptions, corrected encounter counts, and field-navigation recovery fixes. Includes the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.
Repairs Floor 63 coupon and duct progression, clears stale room selections, and follows live crawlspace route bends. Includes the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.

Corrects the native Floor 63 D16 and C Coupon route, retains short obstacle-recovery steps for manual navigation and auto-walk, and restores FFNx-wrapped highlighted choice tracking. Includes the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.
Adds Nibelheim flashback Story and Object guidance, scripted guest-party battle reading, and non-repeating Reform party-slot speech. Includes the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.

Restores post-reactor Nibelheim Story guidance and FFNx-wrapped choice speech, and adds native front/back row and swap announcements to the Steam 2026 Order menu. Includes the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.
Blind Soldier 0.3.0 improves native menu and dialogue coverage, mounted world-map accessibility, and Nibelheim flashback guidance. Includes the trimmed 2013 x86 payload.
Version-aligned 2013 x86 package; the functional change restores Steam 2026 x64 world-map menu speech.
Field navigation through the Midgar slums, the Mythril Mine and Fort Condor; PHS screen speech restored; a Midgar Zolom marsh warning.

First Blind Soldier build to speak for JAWS and other non-NVDA screen readers on the 2013 runtime. Prism 0.18.0 fixes the x86 backend-selection crash, and Blind Soldier now follows a reader started, stopped, or switched during play. Reported by sanslash332.

Fixes the accessible launcher, which closed immediately on startup in 0.4.1 for every user. Adds full speech for the Fort Condor fort battle: the hire list with each unit's stats, where a unit can be placed and how far, casualties and the enemy advance gauge during the battle, and who won.

No change in play. First build made under the new Prism speech-library guards, which keep the launcher crash fixed in 0.5.0 from ever coming back: the launcher's description of Prism's configuration is now checked against the library itself on every build, every push, and at release.
